_comment: Windsurf (Codeium) MCP configuration. Save to ~/.codeium/windsurf/mcp_config.json. Windsurf uses the flat 'mcpServers' format. After saving, open Windsurf -> Cascade panel -> hammer icon -> Configure to verify the server is listed. Replace the vault path before use. On Windows, you may need to use an absolute python path (e.g. C:/Python311/python.exe) if 'python' is not on PATH for GUI-launched apps.
